findings.title: sys-fleet's paths in systems.yaml omit test/fixtures/fleet/.
findings.evidence: docs/08-governance/systems.yaml:617-629 lists test/test_fleet_files.py but not its fixture directory, a declared deliverable.

findings.title: The review runner did not run the phase's negated-grep verification.
findings.evidence: Manifest _working/review-checks/phase-rep-01/c864d660cea8/: `! grep -n "Session Manager\|GOV-017" test/test_fleet_files.py` -> ran false, not run: not a command.
findings.consequence: Acceptance 4 had no runner evidence; the judge checked it by reading the file. Process gap in tools/run_review_checks.py, not a phase defect.

notes: Shadow review, dispatched by the Session Manager after the runner finished (manifest _working/review-checks/phase-rep-01/c864d660cea8/, passed).
